info.desc: RENAISSANCE is the seventh studio album by Beyoncé, released on July 29, 2022, via Parkwood Entertainment and Columbia Records. It is her first solo studio release since Lemonade and serves as the first installment of a trilogy project. Beam, Grace Jones and Tems appear as guest vocalists. Beyoncé conceived and recorded Renaissance during the COVID-19 pandemic, seeking to inspire joy and escapism in listeners who had experienced isolation and to celebrate a club era in which marginalized people sought liberation through dance music. With its songs seamlessly arranged like a DJ mix, the album blends post-1970s Black dance music styles .

podcast.body: Upon the release of this album in 2022, Beyoncé's team granted songwriting co-credit to Alan George and Fred McFarlane for the track "Break My Soul." This decision was made despite "Break My Soul" sounding nothing like the original 1990 version of "Show Me Love" co-written by George and McFarlane, highlighting complexities in copyright attribution. "In 2022, as Beyoncé's Renaissance album came out, her team awarded songwriting co-credit to Alan George and Fred McFarlane, the two men who wrote the original Show Me Love, which sounds nothing like Break My Soul."
